_doc: Cleo beta UI string catalogue (M3-03, ROUND-3 gap #8). Source of truth for interface copy; published as beta/assets/i18n/<locale>.json. Place names, record write-ups and source names are DATA, never in a catalogue and never machine-translated. A locale is offered in the switcher only when its file sets "reviewed": true (a human reviewer signed it).
